answers.core: It could admittedly be an addon, assuming the code to focus a node is exposed to the scripting API, but this is a fairly universal feature. Plus, since the code to focus a node is already in core, this should be relatively easy to add.
answers.workaround: As far as I know, there is no way to enable auto focusing nodes.
